name: flogo-mbclient-trigger
title: Modbus Client Completion Trigger
description: Emits an event when a Modbus request from the Modbus Client activity completes

output.name: activityName
output.description: Name of the activity that completed the request

output.name: request
output.description: Input values used for the Modbus request

output.name: value
output.description: Decoded Modbus response, when the request succeeds

output.name: error
output.description: Error message, when the Modbus request fails
